description: Turn images, sent as base64 or public URLs in order, into one PDF. JPEG and PNG are embedded directly. Other formats are converted to PNG first. Page size is A4, Letter, or fit. Private addresses are refused. Returns the PDF as base64.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

name: images_to_pdf
title: Build a PDF from images
